WITH grouped_data AS (
  SELECT 
    o.timespan,
    AVG(CASE 
      WHEN f.rebrate IS NOT NULL AND f.feerate IS NOT NULL AND f.feerate != 0 
      THEN f.rebrate / f.feerate 
      ELSE NULL 
    END) as avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) as match_count
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(match_count) as avg_match_count
  FROM grouped_data
),
filtered_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    gd.timespan,
    gd.avg_ratio,
    gd.match_count
  FROM grouped_data gd
  WHERE gd.match_count > (SELECT avg_match_count FROM stats)
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_ratio) as avg_of_avg_ratios,
  SUM(match_count) as total_match_count,
  AVG(match_count - (SELECT avg_match_count FROM stats)) as avg_excess
FROM filtered_groups;
